verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's ingestion docs say native ClickHouse ingestion paths work: INSERT, the Kafka table engine, and the s3() and url() table functions. Any ClickHouse client or driver also connects unchanged. That covers streaming and object-storage sources only. The evidence names no SaaS-app connectors, no database CDC connectors, and no ETL/ELT partners such as Fivetran or Airbyte, and per-source setup guides are only implied. The listed BI tools are query consumers, not ingestion sources. Missing for 10: SaaS-app connectors, database-source connectors, named ETL/ELT partner integrations, per-connector setup documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, first-party and partner connectors cover my sources — SaaS apps, databases, and ETL/ELT tools — with documented setup

citations.quote: INSERT, the Kafka table engine, the s3() and url() table functions, materialized views, all work as documented
every ClickHouse client and driver works against ObsessionDB unchanged. You change the host and credentials, nothing else.
